message: After that—I was in no state to hold class, so I sent everyone home early.
Then I wandered all over the place looking for Setsugekka and Momiji...

name: Iori
message: 「So this is where you were, Momiji」
The one I found first was Momiji.

name: Momiji
message: 「...What？」
Momiji was sitting on the seawall, silently gazing out at the sea reflecting the setting sun with a bored look on her face.

name: Iori
message: 「Mind if I sit next to you？」

name: Momiji
message: 「Do whatever you want」
She replied curtly. She seemed to be in a bad mood.

name: Iori
message: 「Oof... Summer break's right around the corner, huh」

name: Momiji
message: 「I suppose」

name: Iori
message: 「Is there anything you want to do over summer break？」

name: Momiji
message: 「Not really」

name: Iori
message: 「Around when are you heading back to your family's place？」

name: Momiji
message: 「Haven't decided yet」

name: Iori
message: 「Momiji...」

name: Momiji
message: 「...Ugh, come on, what is it!」
She glared at me, looking annoyed.

name: Momiji
message: 「If you've got something to say, just say it already. Dragging it out just ticks me off!」

name: Iori
message: 「Then I'll ask you straight up」

name: Iori
message: 「You've known for a while now, haven't you？」

name: Iori
message: 「That if she couldn't become Toujinegi, Setsugekka might end up leaving the academy」

name: Iori
message: 「So I was right」

name: Momiji
message: 「Ugh, so annoying—stop reading my expression!」
Momiji and Setsugekka were always bickering loudly, yet in truth, the two of them were very close.
She must have heard about it from Setsugekka beforehand.

name: Iori
message: 「Did you know even before the finals？」

name: Momiji
message: 「……I knew」
Quitting the academy because she couldn't beat Suzakuin. I can't believe she made a decision that big just yesterday or today.
Setsugekka must have decided ahead of time.
And Momiji knew about Setsugekka's decision beforehand.

name: Iori
message: 「I see……Sorry, I wasn't considerate enough for you」

name: Momiji
message: 「That's not something Sensei needs to apologize for, right?」

name: Iori
message: 「Maybe not……Still, it frustrates me. That I couldn't be there for how Momiji felt」

name: Momiji
message: 「……Stop saying things like that, it's unfair」

name: Iori
message: 「Unfair？」
I didn't really understand what was unfair or how.

name: Iori
message: 「Don't you want to do something about Setsugekka？」

name: Momiji
message: 「Do something, like what？」

name: Iori
message: 「Momiji, are you okay with Setsugekka leaving？」

name: Momiji
message: 「……If you listened to what was said earlier, you'd get it, right? There's no doing anything about that」

name: Momiji
message: 「Setsugekka and Keisetsu are of one mind and body, you can't separate them」

name: Momiji
message: 「Keisetsu has the ambition to become head of the house, and Setsugekka wants Keisetsu to fulfill that ambition」

name: Momiji
message: 「Which means, unless you somehow crush Keisetsu's ambition, you can't alter Setsugekka's actions following along with it」

name: Momiji
message: 「So？ You think persuading Keisetsu like, 'Hey, maybe you don't have to become head after all,' would actually work？」

name: Momiji
message: 「No way, right? Dead end」

name: Momiji
message: 「Another option: smash the trust between Setsugekka and Keisetsu. Basically, sow discord between them」

name: Momiji
message: 「If we really tried, maybe we could pull it off. But if we did that, we'd make an enemy of the entire Kazamine family」

name: Momiji
message: 「Brainwash Setsugekka into cutting ties with Keisetsu. Might be possible, though I think Keisetsu would get seriously mad」

name: Momiji
message: 「Do you have the resolve to go all-out against that Keisetsu, Sensei？」

name: Iori
message: 「Th-that's……」

name: Momiji
message: 「Obviously I thought of things on this level, and after thinking them through, I gave up because there's neither feasibility nor benefit」

name: Momiji
message: 「So, you really think this can be fixed somehow？」

name: Iori
message: 「Sorry about that. That was an inconsiderate thing to say.」
It looks like I rubbed Momiji the wrong way.

name: Momiji
message: 「...I don't even care about Setsugekka anymore.」

name: Iori
message: 「No, you can't just not care...」

name: Momiji
message: 「I mean, you're leaving too, aren't you, Iori-sensei?」
I'm at a loss for words.

name: Momiji
message: 「The Tenju Special Forces told you to come back, right？」

name: Iori
message: 「...You knew about that too?」

name: Momiji
message: 「I heard it from Setsugekka.」

name: Momiji
message: 「That's why Setsugekka is leaving the academy too, isn't it?」

name: Momiji
message: 「Once the biggest reason to stay at the academy is gone, of course you'd just feel like, 'Whatever, who cares anymore.'」
Momiji, gazing out at the sea with a look of utter resignation.

name: Iori
message: 「...Even if that's true, what are you going to do, Momiji？」

name: Momiji
message: 「Nothing much... I'll just go my own way—do everything myself and stay on my own. Just go back to being a Suzakuin, I guess~」

name: Iori
message: 「Asahi and Ririmu are still in Takamura Class, though...」

name: Momiji
message: 「I know, I know.」

name: Momiji
message: 「I really have gotten close with both of them, and it's not like I plan on cutting ties or anything, so you don't need to worry.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Not that it'll have anything to do with you anyway, since you won't be here by then, Sensei.」
I couldn't say a word.
Only the sound of the waves echoes all around us.

name: Momiji
message: 「...You know」

name: Momiji
message: 「I won the Martial Festival and became the Toujinegi, and yet... I don't feel happy at all.」

name: Momiji
message: 「I worked so hard to get stronger so I could become the Toujinegi, and you helped me out so much, Sensei」

name: Momiji
message: 「I lived up to everyone's expectations, and my wish finally came true, and yet」

name: Momiji
message: 「Why do I feel so empty...」
Looking closely, I saw a tiny tear welling up in Momiji's eyes.

name: Momiji
message: Setsugekka and Keisetsu are gone, and Sensei is gone too.

name: Momiji
message: What was I even working so hard for……

name: Momiji
message: Why was I doing Jindou……？

name: Momiji
message: The further forward I stepped, the more painful it got……

name: Momiji
message: I've lost way more than I've gained……！

name: Momiji
message: There's nothing good at all about winning……！

name: Momiji
message: Why do I have to feel like this……！？

name: Iori
message: 「Momiji...」
Momiji had known from the start. That this is what would happen if she won the finals.
Even though she knew, made up her mind, and supposedly chose this path herself.

name: Momiji
message: Really…… if it was going to be like this, I wish I'd never been born a Suzakuin……！

name: Momiji
message: I never should've become a swordsman, damn it……！
The reason Momiji talked about standing on her own whenever she got the chance wasn't because she genuinely wanted to, but
Because people around her demanded she be strong, and to live up to that
To spur herself on as a Suzakuin――
She had no choice but to rely on standing alone. That was all it was.

name: Iori
message: ……I'm glad, though. That Momiji's a normal girl too.
I'd always thought it. That Momiji was pushing herself somewhere along the line.
Yet up until today, she had never once complained to anyone around her.

name: Momiji
message: It's not good, there's nothing good about it……！ This is just painful, isn't it！

name: Momiji
message: Sensei dragged me out when I didn't want to, and made me take lessons with everyone else！

name: Momiji
message: Made us get along and let me have fun and all！

name: Momiji
message: To snatch that away right when I…… started thinking maybe this kind of thing isn't so bad, that's way too cruel……！

name: Momiji
message: If I'd just stayed on my own from the start, if things had stayed the way they were, I wouldn't have had to feel like this……

name: Momiji
message: It's only this hard because Sensei pulled me in, because Sensei taught me……！

name: Momiji
message: All of this, every bit of it, is Sensei's fault, isn't it！！

name: Iori
message: ……Yeah, you're right. It's my fault.
If she'd never known, she wouldn't have suffered. Momiji's pain is practically something I gave her.

name: Momiji
message: Sniff…… what am I supposed to do from here……？ What should I have done……！？

name: Momiji
message: 「Tell me, Iori-sensei...！！！」
I know all too well the feelings Momiji is experiencing and suffering through right now.

name: Iori
message: 「...I'm still inexperienced, and there's so much I don't know. So I can't do anything as grand as teaching you.」

name: Iori
message: 「But... as someone walking just a little bit ahead of you, I think there's something I can pass on.」
I hand Momiji a handkerchief and let her wipe away her tears.

name: Iori
message: 「...I think I told you before, but I had a best friend.」

name: Iori
message: 「Ever since I injured him and we graduated, up until just recently, I'd been completely out of touch with him.」

name: Iori
message: 「And the other day, I finally got to talk with Takahisa.」

name: Momiji
message: 「...I see.」

name: Iori
message: 「He hadn't changed a bit. Cheerful, smooth-talking, and a genuinely good guy...」

name: Iori
message: 「Takahisa was the one who taught me.」

name: Iori
message: 「...Don't let go of what's precious to you so easily.」

name: Iori
message: 「Acting like some tragic hero and pretending to shoulder all the guilt doesn't do anyone any good.」

name: Iori
message: 「If anything, it just ends up hurting the important people around you who care about you—that's what he told me.」

name: Iori
message: 「Hearing Takahisa say that made me realize it. I really was a fool.」

name: Iori
message: 「I robbed Takahisa of his dream.」

name: Iori
message: 「Someone like me doesn't deserve to chase his own dream and become a teacher—that's what I kept telling myself all this time.」

name: Iori
message: 「Until Takahisa forgives me, there's nothing I can do. I kept believing all I could do was wait.」

name: Iori
message: 「But that was just an excuse I made to myself.」

name: Iori
message: 「To put it simply, I'd given up on my own. On my dream, and on Takahisa.」

name: Iori
message: 「Making excuses to myself, I ended up wasting precious time ever since graduating from the academy.」

name: Iori
message: 「Talking with Takahisa finally made me understand that.」
I don't regret joining the GSDF. I deeply treasure both the experiences and the comrades I gained there.
Even so, if only I had reached out to Takahisa sooner. If only I hadn't given up on my dream and had become a teacher.
These feelings, this regret lingering in my chest—I'm sure they will never fade from my heart for as long as I live.
I don't want Momiji to ever feel that way.

name: Iori
message: 「Momiji, if there's something truly precious to you, don't give up on it.」

name: Iori
message: 「Even if it's pathetic, even if it ends up being pointless, you should struggle until the very, very end.」

name: Iori
message: 「If you easily give up on or let go of something precious to you, you'll regret it for the rest of your life.」

name: Iori
message: 「One fool like that is plenty—me alone is enough.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Sensei...」

name: Iori
message: 「Momiji, there are things only you can do.」

name: Iori
message: 「There have to be words that only you can get through to them—」
Yes, just like Takahisa told me.
Things that only someone precious—only someone who truly cares—can melt away, feelings only they can untangle.
I'm sure those exist in this world.

name: Momiji
message: 「...Hehe, what's with that?」

name: Momiji
message: 「Really... Iori-sensei, you say weirdly sappy stuff sometimes, you know.」

name: Iori
message: 「Not satisfied with that answer？」
I ask her the same way I did back then.

name: Momiji
message: 「It's not like it's bad or anything, buuut...」

name: Iori
message: 「But？」

name: Momiji
message: 「Well, if Sensei says so, maybe giving it a shot could be fun, nya~」

name: Momiji
message: 「Just kidding!」

name: Momiji
message: 「Thanks, Iori-sensei. I'll think it over a bit.」
Thank goodness. Looks like she's finally warming up to the idea.

name: Iori
message: 「...Hey, Momiji.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Hmm~？」

name: Iori
message: 「I actually have one pretty good idea.」

name: Momiji
message: 「A good idea？」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah. I call it Operation 'Never Let the Green Grass Wither.'」
I flash a grin.

name: Momiji
message: 「Hmm, so you're planning to scheme something sneaky again.」
Leave it to Momiji—she got it without me even having to say a word.

name: Iori
message: 「How about it, feel like getting in on this？」

name: Momiji
message: 「Hehe, sure. I'm in.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Well, no telling how far we'll get, though.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Nothing to lose—let's flail around pathetically！」

name: Iori
message: 「You bet！」
Momiji and I bumped fists.
